title: BLE packet loss and the 500 ms failsafe
description: Wall 1.2 m ahead. Every packet is dropped from 2.0 to 3.2 s: the firmware holds the last bands, then neutralises 500 ms after the last packet. From 4 to 6 s, 30 % random loss (fixed seed) must not cause a dropout. The blackout begins right after the phone's presence tap at 1.95 s; the firmware's held-drop rule (kHeldDropMs = 150) raises the tapped pins again when no packet follows, so the wall is held, not the tap, until the watchdog fires.
